usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks and Microsoft Outlook holds your mail, so “New Task Created in Project” runs “Create Draft Email”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Draft Email” in Microsoft Outlook
bestTemplate.why: A new task leaves a draft email waiting in Outlook, so you only review and send.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist is polling, so the draft appears after a scheduled check.
